method.summary: Create a receiver-local reading-focus layout without copying another user's private configuration.
steps: Identify the target application and its native Omarchy or application configuration surface.
Create the smallest receiver-local change that hides nonessential chrome while preserving an obvious exit path.
Keep the change in a user-owned configuration location and do not overwrite an existing file.
verification: Confirm the target application still launches.
Confirm the owner can restore the prior layout without deleting unrelated configuration.
Confirm no private configuration was fetched from another user.
